scope: Eight bounded assignment contracts through four shell aliases compare original GNU output, status and private file effects with the immutable candidate. Indexed and associative values, local/global compound assignment, readonly diagnostics and ordinary invalid arithmetic/index expressions exercise ownership transfers and cleanup. Complete child memory logs are retained; native GNU findings remain separate.

results.name: bash:local-index-error
args: f(){ local a; a=([x+]=value); printf unreachable; }; f; printf "outer:%s\n" "$?"

args: f(){ declare -ga a=([x+]=value); printf "function:%s\n" "$?"; }; f; printf "outer:%s\n" "$?"
